about: A general practice: check-ups, cleanings, fillings, crowns and the things that come up in between. Two evenings a week run late so an appointment does not have to cost a day off work.
Everything gets explained before it happens, with the picture on the screen in front of you. If a treatment can reasonably be watched rather than done, you will be told that too.

faq.a: Ring reception and ask — it changes, and they will tell you honestly.
Tuesday and Thursday run until seven.

faq.q: What if I am in pain today?
faq.a: Ring first thing. There is time kept free each day for exactly this.
There is parking behind the building, off the lane beside the entrance.
